name: Modelmesh
short: Model marketplace aggregator brokering access to 290+ third-party models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, xAI, Tencent, Alibaba, Intern, Agnes, …) via OpenAI-compatible APIs; public per-token pricing in CNY, actual cost varies by routing provider.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.price: Per-1M-token usage pricing in CNY (varies by model; several models listed at ¥0/M input and output)
plans.notes: Actual pricing may vary when routed to different providers. See model details for per-model pricing.
